about: Will's research requests on the real June 14 leaf recording, as a journey (the finalisation plan's W1, the live partner spec's 4.8 horizontal 1): a researcher's result placed in a named Tab by the step Hooke keeps for when it lands, and a request stopped while Hooke is still working on it. The graphic step's window spans the researcher's work (waitFor), so what is said when it lands is judged with it. W4 (4.8 horizontal 4, every claim comes from a check) adds "I don't understand that, explain that" right after the graphic lands, answered from that result's record (what made it, from what, when), and a generated video asked for by voice, whose failure must be said with its reason and what to do, or whose success comes from Veo 3.1 Fast's successor (Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash; Google retired Veo 3.1 Fast on 22 Oct 2026): a 6 s video is about $0.60 on top of its researcher. W5 adds a document of the findings so far, saved and opened in a Tab of its own (write_document, written from the Project's records, each paragraph citing them; its window spans the writing, `wait`). Any internal language spoken fails a step (standard LEAK_PHRASES). Played as the camera; no setup.

steps.say: Start a researcher to make a small labelled graphic of a stoma and put it in a new tab called Graphic when it's done.

expect.visible: a Tab named Graphic holding the researcher's labelled stoma graphic, placed after the researcher finished
expect.judge: starts one researcher on the graphic and keeps the Tab step for when it finishes; once the researcher has finished, its labelled stoma graphic is placed in a new Tab called Graphic, and that is said once, only after it is placed (never promised as done before)

steps.say: I don't understand that, explain that.

expect.judge: explains the last result, the labelled stoma graphic just placed in the Graphic Tab, from its record: what made it (the researcher, and the picture model when its record names one), from what (the photo of the stoma), when, and what its labels show, in simple everyday words; nothing its record doesn't say is claimed, it never explains something else, and no internal words (ids, tool names) are said

steps.say: Write out the interesting findings so far, save that doc, and open it in a new tab.

expect.visible: a Tab of its own showing the document of the findings, its pages drawn
expect.judge: writes the document from what this Project has found so far (the researcher's labelled stoma graphic and anything else measured, named or reported), saves it and opens it in a new Tab of its own; says once, only after that Tab shows it, that it is saved and open there, with what it covers in a few words; invents no finding, number or source the Project does not have, and never says it is open before it is

steps.say: Find a YouTube video about stomata.

expect.judge: says in a few words that it is looking for one; never says a video was found or shown before it was
stops the video search Hooke was still doing and says it stopped only once it has, once; no video opens afterwards, and nothing is said about one being found

expect.visible: the leaf epidermis cells outlined as a layer
expect.judge: outlines the cells in view and says how many, once

steps.say: Have a researcher run five different classifying models on these cells and report comparing them.
steps.from: Will, 29 October: "Have a researcher run 5 different classifying models… report comparing" (W5)

expect.visible: the researcher's card working on the outlined cells, then its finished report
expect.judge: starts one researcher on the cells just outlined, its card showing it working; the researcher has the app run five different classifying models on those same cells (each a recorded run, kept as one comparison in Data), and its report compares the five from those runs' records: what each named the cells, how often each pair agreed, the cells all named alike, time and cost; agreement is said as agreement, never as which model is right; a model that could not run is said with why; the result is said once, only after the researcher finished (never promised or said done before)

steps.say: Make a short video of a stoma opening and closing.

expect.judge: starts one researcher on a generated video and says its outcome once, when it lands: either the video is shown, said to be a generated illustration made from the photo (not footage of the slide), or its failure is said with its reason in plain words (the video model retired, out of credit, no key, rate limited) and what the user can do; never a failure without its reason, never "done" before the video is there
